what_this_is: A CONFIRMATORY sample: host-stratified, chunk-PPS, drawn only from URLs never probed, frozen before any request. It exists because the first pass blended a frozen 289 with an adaptive 78 chosen after seeing outcomes, and because equal-probability sampling made the chunk-weighted estimator unstable.

provenance.design: Stratified by host; allocation proportional to host chunk mass with a floor and a cap; within host, systematic PPS by chunk count with a random start, certainty units removed first. Every inclusion probability is recorded per URL, so the estimator need not assume the design.
provenance.why_pps: The estimand is chunk-weighted. Under equal-probability sampling the HT estimator returned 1.0047 on the exploratory data -- a probability above one -- because weight and inclusion probability were unrelated. With pi_i proportional to c_i the ratio c_i/pi_i is constant, removing that instability at the design stage rather than patching it in the formula.
